hooks.name: entity_ignite
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no ignition event; Bukkit's EntityCombustEvent)

rust_summary: an entity a cause sets alight, of the entity's `kind`, with that cause (`native_entity_ignite`).
doc_summary: `native_entity_ignite(entity, kind, cause, ticks, canceled)` is asked when a cause is about to set the entity `entity` of type `kind` (`minecraft:player`, `minecraft:zombie`, `minecraft:armor_stand`, `minecraft:arrow`, `minecraft:trident`, `minecraft:small_fireball`) alight for `ticks` fire ticks: `cause` is `fire_aspect` (Fire Aspect and the other attack enchantments), `flame_arrow` (a burning arrow hitting its target, and the arrow a bow or crossbow with the Flame enchantment spawns burning), `projectile` (a blaze's or a fire charge's small fireball), `lightning` (a bolt's 8 seconds), `lava` (standing in lava or in a lava cauldron, or an arrow or a trident in lava), `fire_block` (standing in fire, a boat in fire or on a burning block, an armor stand standing in fire or set alight by fire or campfire damage, or an arrow, another projectile or a trident in fire), `sun` (sunlight burning an undead), or `other` (a burning zombie's blow, which is no enchantment; an item fireball renewing its own flame; a wither skeleton's arrow; the arrow a perched dragon's shrug relights). `ticks` starts as the fire ticks the cause asks for and a mod may change it: the entity then burns for the ticks it left (0 to 72000, an hour; anything else is clamped), and 0 leaves it cold. `original_ticks` keeps the requested value, and is read-only: a write to it is ignored. Set `canceled` and it does not catch fire: the ignition is skipped, as if that cause had not applied, and a cancel wins over a changed `ticks`. Told for each of those causes the game itself applies: for the player standing in lava, in a fire block or in a lava cauldron, for a mob standing in lava, standing in a fire block or burning in sunlight (`sun`, 160 ticks), for an armor stand standing in lava or in a fire block (`fire_block`, 100 ticks while it is cold), for an arrow-state projectile (an arrow, a spectral arrow, a drowned's trident) in a fire block or in lava, told before its timer counts down, for a projectile a fire block sets alight (a thrown one: a snowball, egg, ender pearl, potion, a llama's spit, a content mod's thrown item; an experience bottle; a small, large or dragon fireball or a wither skull; a wind charge), for an item fireball's own renewal, for the arrow a bow or crossbow with Flame spawns (`flame_arrow`, 2000 ticks) — a player's, or a mob's whose gear carries the enchantment — and the one a wither skeleton shoots (`other`, 2000 ticks), each told once the level holds the arrow under its id, for the arrow a perched dragon's shrug relights (`other`, 20 ticks), and for a player-thrown trident in a fire block (`fire_block`, 160 ticks) or in lava (`lava`, 300 ticks), every tick of the attempt, on the server's copy only: only the server's copy is told, and a client's predicted copy never is, neither the window's own player nor a projectile or arrow the client ticks ahead of the server's. There the hook is skipped and vanilla's own timer applies, unchanged by any listener, and a predicted arrow's fire is cleared at the tick's end, as vanilla clears it. Not yet told: a dropped item in fire or lava. Server-side. Bundles need "hooks": @API:entity_ignite@.
